score_policy.sensitivity: If screen contains flagged texts, separately report predeclared nontruncated subset as sensitivity only; no replacement of primary qualification.
score_policy.dynamic_degree: Guard only; no automatic acceptance threshold or quality ranking
score_policy.unrequested_metric_handling: Not applicable, not missing or failed; do not impute or compute other-domain diagnostic scores
score_policy.dynamic_guard_scope: Motion domain only; no claim about motion preservation on visual_semantic outputs

statistics.resampling_unit: prompt; all 3 seeds and both arms resampled together, within each official domain
